title: On the Design Space of Continuous Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.13834v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) promise to bring the benefits of continuous flow modelling to language, including accelerated sampling and controllable generation. The field has grown rapidly, and the capabilities of CDLMs have begun to rival those of discrete diffusion. Yet, unlike for continuous modalities such as images or videos, our grasp of the levers that matter when training CDLMs remains limited. In this work, we focus on two of these levers, namely self-conditioning and embedding geometry, and shed light on some of the mechanisms behind them, which in turn suggest cheaper and more effective designs. We begin by showing that self-conditioning corrects a train/inference mismatch by exposing the model to inference-like states that are otherwise rare during training. translated_title: 连续扩散语言模型的设计空间
translated_abstract: 连续扩散语言模型（CDLMs）有望将连续流建模的优势引入语言领域，包括加速采样和可控生成。该领域发展迅速，CDLMs的能力已开始与离散扩散模型相媲美。然而，与图像或视频等连续模态不同，我们对训练CDLMs时哪些关键因素起决定作用的认知仍然有限。在本工作中，我们聚焦于其中两个因素，即自条件化和嵌入几何，并揭示了它们背后的一些机制，这些机制进而启发了更廉价、更有效的设计。我们首先证明，自条件化通过让模型接触到推理时才会出现、而在训练过程中较为罕见的状态，从而纠正了训练与推理之间的不匹配。这些增益可以通过一种二级插值方法——我们称之为 $\mathrm{DoubleCat}$——在不增加额外前向传播的情况下获得，该方法在TinyGSM任务上的准确率提升更……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究揭示了连续扩散语言模型中自条件化通过纠正训练/推理不匹配而生效的机制，并提出了无需额外前向传播的二级插值方法DoubleCat，从而实现更廉价且更有效的设计。
en_tdlr: This work demystifies self-conditioning and embedding geometry in continuous diffusion language models, showing that self-conditioning corrects a train/inference mismatch, and proposes DoubleCat, a two-level interpolant that recovers these gains without an extra forward pass.
